Name: Kenneth's Witch Garden Roses
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Witch Garden Roses - Content Patcher[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod adds 9 new garden roses: Amber, Blood, Blush, Ebony, Frost, Ivory, Mystic, Ocean and Sunshine Garden Rose.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All roses are regrowable and seasonal. They grow in spring, summer, fall and winter depending on the variety.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Each rose can be brewed into a rose potion.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Seeds are sold at Kenneth's Seed Shop.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Rose potions are sold at Kenneth's Drink Shop.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]All potions can also be cooked with cooking recipes.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod is balanced for vanilla gameplay and designed to fit naturally into the game. The roses work as flowers and as gift items.[/b][/size]
